name: Wraithgate
detailed_description:
Wraithgate

🔹 Hardcore 4-Player Co-op Shooter | Nightmarish Monsters | Deadly Expeditions

The Wraithgate has opened, calling those who dare to step into the darkness—never to return. Wraithgate is a brutal 4-player co-op shooter, dragging you deeper into ever-darkening dimensions filled with grotesque mutants, eldritch horrors, and one undeniable truth: Death is permanent.

🕱 HARDCORE SURVIVAL – NO MERCY, NO SECOND CHANCES

Every expedition is a leap into the unknown, but few make it out alive. Resources are scarce, ammo is limited, and the creatures lurking in the dark will never let you rest. If you die, you’re gone. No respawns. No forgiveness.

👹 NIGHTMARISH ENEMIES – THE DARKNESS IS ALIVE

From twisted mutants to unthinkable abominations, everything is hunting you. Each level of the Wraithgate becomes more dangerous, the shadows grow deeper, and the horrors more relentless. Your only hope? Work together, stay sharp, and fight for every second you have left.

🔫 CUSTOM LOADOUTS – SURVIVAL HAS A PRICE

Choose from a deadly arsenal—but choose wisely. Each mission brings new threats, and what saved you yesterday might get you killed today. You are not a hero. You are prey.

🎮 BRUTAL 4-PLAYER CO-OP

Your team is your lifeline. Heal each other, cover each other—or die alone. The real question isn’t if you’ll survive, but how far you’ll make it before the Wraithgate devours you.

⏳ THE COUNTDOWN BEGINS – HOW FAR WILL YOU GO?

The descent begins soon. Gear up, make a plan, and pray you make it back.

💀 Death is final. And the Wraithgate never closes. 💀
